name: StepQuay
subtitle: Resume your next small task
description:
StepQuay keeps your next small action in the menu bar so you can return to it after an interruption.

Build an ordered queue with estimated effort for each action. Enter your available time to preview which consecutive actions fit. Overflow stays in your queue.

When you pause, save a short resume note. Read it when you return and resume the remaining time. Sleep pauses active timing and requires you to resume after waking.

An expired timer never completes your work. Continue, revise the remaining effort, or defer the action. Finish when you are done and undo a completion if needed. Local history keeps estimated and active time with your interruption notes.

Open the panel with Command Option K or choose a different shortcut in Settings. Use Command Return to start, Command I to interrupt, Command R to resume, and Command F to finish.

Try Sample explores a fictional launch checklist without changing your live queue. Settings include history retention and local history deletion.

Your actions, notes, and history stay on your Mac. There are no accounts, analytics, cloud sync, or app network requests.
